name: PPA Adjudication Producer

publicMethods.name: adjudicate
publicMethods.output: receipt-record (status ACCEPTED | REJECTED | UNDETERMINED, adapter_submit QUEUED | EMIT_FAILED)

publicMethods.name: submit_receipt
publicMethods.output: retry of the emit to the Adapter (QUEUED | ALREADY_QUEUED | EMIT_FAILED)

owns: producer receipts: normalized observation envelope, evidence_hash (sha256 over canonical content), decision status
emit state to the Adapter (PENDING | QUEUED | EMIT_FAILED)
doesNotOwn: receipt trustworthiness — the Adapter judges origin, the Core gates execution

canonicalDecision.rule: ACCEPTED iff (satisfied=true, verdict=delivered, confidence=high); REJECTED iff (false, not_delivered, high); everything else — ambiguous, low confidence, malformed model output, evidence unavailable — fails closed to UNDETERMINED.

boundary.authorityPath: adjudicate() → gl.nondet.web.render + gl.nondet.exec_prompt under gl.vm.run_nondet → canonicalization → evidence_hash → cross-contract emit(on="accepted").submit_decision_receipt to the bound Adapter.
boundary.identity: The Adapter must observe msg.sender = this contract's address. The owner EOA never submits producer receipts on its behalf.
boundary.honest-labeling: adapter_submit is QUEUED, never EMITTED — the producer cannot observe the Adapter's acceptance. Delivery is proven by Adapter-side readback.
boundary.replay: Duplicate decision_id → REJECTED_REPLAY; questions are immutable once registered.

component: PPA Adjudication Producer — the judgment source of the Core/Adapter/Producer split
